title: Arrearage Management Program Catch-Up Forgiveness Amount — Calculation Memo
content:
# Arrearage Management Program Catch-Up Forgiveness Amount — Calculation Memo

This memorandum sets the amount of a catch-up forgiveness posted on an Arrearage Management Program plan, the forgiveness kind of Payment Arrangement.

## 1. The amount

The catch-up forgiveness is the scheduled installment times the catch-up share, never more than the remaining forgiveness room, rounded half-up to the cent.

## 2. The scheduled installment

The scheduled installment is the plan's remaining balance when the installment is the last one of the plan not yet forgiven or billed — that is, when the forgiveness entries and installment billings on the plan together number one less than its installment count — and otherwise the plan's regular installment amount, but never more than its remaining balance.

## 3. The catch-up share

The catch-up share is one, less the lateness cut and less the late-charge cut, plus the progress credit and plus the autopay credit; these are first added together into one share, which is then held between zero and one before it is applied once to the scheduled installment. The standard catch-up share is one, so that the whole scheduled installment is forgiven. The days late are counted, as standard, from the bill's due date to the date it was paid in full.

## 4. The remaining forgiveness room

The remaining forgiveness room is the program's lifetime forgiveness cap per customer less the forgiveness already posted on the plan, the customer's forgiveness on earlier program plans having already limited the plan's balance when it was enrolled.

## Worked memo (hypothetical 12-installment plan, program cap $8000.00)

| Line | Plan A | Plan B | Plan C |
|---|---|---|---|
| Regular installment amount | $187.25 | $187.25 | $187.25 |
| Remaining balance | $1310.75 | $187.31 | $1310.75 |
| Forgiveness entries and billings so far | 5 | 11 (one less than 12) | 5 |
| Scheduled installment | $187.25 | $187.31, the remaining balance | $187.25 |
| Forgiveness already posted on the plan | $3410.00 | $5000.00 | $7900.00 |
| Remaining room | $4590.00 | $3000.00 | $100.00 |
| Catch-up share | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Catch-up forgiveness | $187.25 | $187.31 | $100.00, held to the room |
